name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Strawberry Watermelon
description: Dive into a juicy fruit pairing with Double-Stacked Strawberry Watermelon BITEZ. Two fruity layers combine rich, sweet strawberry with juicy, refreshing watermelon for a smooth, candy-inspired flavor that delivers summer sweetness with every chew. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). Two classic fruit flavors, stacked into one seriously potent bite.
